title: Changing session job hash requires re-warming jobs before enabling cached reads
answers: How to roll out a cache key change for marketing session precompute
Old session jobs not reused after changing cache_key_context
Cached attribution slow after job hash change
body:
Changing the `cache_key_context` serialization orphans old jobs whose key changes; there is no compatibility lookup for old keys.
In this PR, old keys with unset `cookielessTrafficIsRegular` stay valid (serialization already omitted None), but explicit true/false keys are new and need warming by the updated writer.
Rollout: warm jobs for the full attribution read window, then confirm complete fresh coverage with a read-only lookup (`ensure_marketing_sessions_precomputed(..., run_inserts=False)`) before enabling cached reads. Missing coverage falls back to live calc.
Regression tests should build legacy jobs via `ensure_precomputed` with the old serialization for each value (None/True/False) and both V2/V3, see test_cookieless_rollout_reuses_jobs_after_cache_key_transition in products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/test_marketing_sessions_precompute.py. Document the transition in docs/internal/marketing-attribution-session-precompute.md.
applies: Any change to the job-hash inputs of marketing sessions precompute.
